leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement basic route handlers for HTTP GET requests in Express
Configure route parameters to capture dynamic values from URLs
Construct route handlers that respond with appropriate HTTP status codes
Apply route chaining to handle multiple HTTP methods on the same path
Initialize and use Express Router to organize routes into modular units
Manipulate request and response objects within route handlers to process and return data
Integrate middleware functions into specific routes for request processing
